# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform support refinements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 improves Linux font discovery and updates platform build support for the m155 release line. Linux applications using the NoDependencies packages can again discover system fonts, while Tizen and Windows native builds move to their current supported toolchains.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m155 integration cleaned up** — Incorporates the m155 core-fork cleanup into the current release line. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — NoDependencies applications on Linux can again locate installed system fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Tizen native builds updated** — Tizen 10 native builds and packages now use the GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **Windows native build tooling aligned** — Windows native builds now align on the v143 toolset and verify Spectre-mitigated build provenance. ([#5238](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5238))
